description: This file defines an interface IChatEvent and several classes implementing it (CreatedEvent, PostedEvent, DeletedEvent, EditedEvent). These classes represent different types of chat events that modify an XML document, likely for event sourcing in a chat application. It uses Orleans serialization attributes and methods to update the document accordingly.

classes.name: IChatEvent
classes.description: Interface for chat events that define how each event modifies an XML document.

classes.name: CreatedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat event when a chat is created, updating the XML document with creation details.

classes.name: PostedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat message posted by a user, adding a post to the XML document.

classes.name: DeletedEvent
classes.description: Represents deletion of a post identified by a GUID, removing it from the XML document.

classes.name: EditedEvent
classes.description: Represents editing a post identified by a GUID, updating its text in the XML document.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Method each event class implements to modify the XML document accordingly.
